title: Minimum Number of Jumps
statement:
Given an array A of N non-negative integers where A[i] represents the maximum number of steps you can jump from index i, find the minimum number of jumps needed to reach the last index from index 0.

If it is impossible to reach the last index, print -1.

Use a greedy approach: track the current reachable range and the farthest point reachable.
inputFormat:
Line 1: a single integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the minimum number of jumps, or -1 if impossible.

examples.explanation: Jump from index 0 (value=2) to index 1 (value=3), then jump to index 4 (value=4) or beyond. Minimum = 2.
A[0]=3, one jump reaches index 3. Done in 1.
